newsitem.title: UK: Westmount Energy expects Falkland work soon.
newsitem.headline: Westmount Energy expects Falkland work soon.

text.p: British oil company Westmount Energy Ld is expected to start seismic work on its exploration venture in the Falklands Islands in early 1997, its chairman said on Thursday.
Westmount has an interest in 30 exploration blocks in offshore north of the Falkland Islands through its 20 percent holding in the Desire Petroleum Ltd.

"It is possible, following the satisfactory completion of this work, that the drilling of one well could commence in 1998," Darek Williams, chairman and chief executive of Westmount told shareholders at its annual general meeting in Jersey.
